title: HWholesome Middle Eastern Pistachio Stir-fry
description: A charred, shaggy Ukrainian dish featuring unsalted pistachio and halal-friendly ingredients that is a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add onion and bell peppers, stirring occasionally, for 4 minutes.
Push vegetables to one side of the wok, add pistachios to the other side.
Shake wok vigorously after adding pistachios. Remove from heat immediately once charred.
Stir in tomato paste and salt, mix well.
Slice chicken breast into strips and add to the wok, stir-fry for 5 minutes or until fully cooked.
Serve hot over rice or with pita bread.
